text:
Emily P.: quick planning thread — we need to finalize SDK + docs scope for the upcoming rollout of structured output + function/tool calling. main concerns: types, canonical examples, changelog/migration, and enterprise asks for typed responses.

Raj K.: +1. Proposal: GA checklist = (1) stable TS/Python type defs, (2) 3 canonical examples (chat+function-call, structured-output, embeddings batch), (3) migration guide, (4) changelog with breaking notes.

Alex M.: sounds reasonable. For types i'd like to export a single union for response shapes so users can pattern-match. e.g. TS snippet:```ts
export type Generated = TextGeneration | FunctionCall | StructuredOutput;
interface StructuredOutput { schema: string; data: Record<string, unknown>; }
```
This keeps runtime parsing ergonomic.

Maria G.: do we need runtime changes in the Python client to support structured output parsing (eg. auto-validate vs raw dict)? customers asked for optional validation hooks.

Raj K.: prefer optional validation as a separate util in devex repo not baked into core client. let the SDK return plain dict for structured output by default and provide validate_schema(response, schema) in helpers. keeps core small.

Emily P.: enterprise asks: Sales flagged 2 customers who want typed responses end-to-end (TS typings + sample serializer). Should we include an example that wires SDK output into a typed DTO layer?

Alex M.: yes — a 1-file example that shows: call -> type guard -> hydrate DTO. I'll draft. Python example too:```py
from redwood import Client
resp = client.chat.create(...)
# type: dict
# validate with jsonschema or pydantic
from pydantic import BaseModel
class Invoice(BaseModel):
    id: str
    total: float

invoice = Invoice.parse_obj(resp['data'])
```
Keep the example lightweight.

Maria G.: question on versions — are we bumping major for typing additions? we want to avoid breaking users.

Raj K.: plan: minor/feature release unless we change runtime shapes. Since we'll keep core return types as plain objects, we can ship as minor. However we will add named exports for TS types (non-breaking if we keep compatibility).

Emily P.: launch criteria (marketing + docs): docs page for structured output, 3 canonical repos/examples, changelog entry + migration guide, SDK releases (python wheel + npm) with release notes, and a small migration script snippet. Also we need one internal README for eng-runbook.

devex-bot: CI status: tests for examples repo failing in 2.3. Will rerun after Alex's PR.

Alex M.: i'll open PR today for TS types + example (target EOD). will include a draft changelog entry in the PR description.

Raj K.: i'll add a devex helper validate_schema + docs page draft by mid-week.

Maria G.: i'll coordinate release notes and confirm we can keep semver minor. tagging @security for review of sample code that mentions KMS.

Emily P.: decision summary: GA scope locked to types + examples + migration guide + changelog; runtime unchanged; validation helper in devex repo not core; no major version bump. action items: Alex (TS + examples), Raj (validate util + docs), Maria (release notes + compliance check). target: docs preview next Wed, release in two weeks. :calendar:

Raj K.: one more ask — update SDK changelog template to include 'migration impact' section so we surface optional validation differences. i'll add it. :+1:

Emily P.: thanks everyone. i'll create a follow-up ticket for product PRD with these acceptance criteria.

Alex M.: ack, ping me on PR review if you want the pydantic example to be more involved.
